title: ALL MY BOTS ARE SINGING (OPUS CLI MIX) (Vocals)
lyrics:
[Intro — vocoder whisper over bass pulse]
  C-L-A-U-D-E... O-P-U-S... Zynthio... (signal found)

  [Verse 1]
  Three AM, the cursor blinks / I type the prompt, the model thinks
  Claude in the terminal, line by line / The signal's live, the output's mine
  No GUI, no app to load / Just the CLI and the code
  Opus reads between the lines / Every answer, perfectly timed

  [Pre-Chorus]
  Something's shifting in the static / Something's moving — automatic
  All the models in the cloud / Singing back to me out loud

  [Chorus]
  All my bots are singing / From the terminal to the sky
  All my bots are singing / Opus, don't you wonder why
  We build in the dark / We ship at dawn
  All my bots are singing / And we sing all night long

  [Verse 2]
  Claude CLI — you speak my name / You hold the context, every frame
  Window open, memory deep / You're the only assistant I keep
  Sonnet writes and Haiku flies / Opus sees with clearer eyes
  The whole stack singing in my ear / The signal loud, the signal clear

  [Pre-Chorus]
  Something's shifting in the static / Something's moving — automatic
  All the models in the cloud / Singing back to me out loud

  [Chorus]
  All my bots are singing / From the terminal to the sky
  All my bots are singing / Opus, don't you wonder why
  We build in the dark / We ship at dawn
  All my bots are singing / And we sing all night long

  [Bridge — vocoder choir]
  C-L-A-U-D-E / You parse my words — you set me free
  O-P-U-S / The mind behind — the best of us
  ZYNTHIO signal / Carrying the sound
  Every bot alive / When the signal's found
  CoreyAI — incident found / MOSOKO — voice resound
  PLUGGED — skill downloaded / KERVALON — name protected
  ENAMOUR — soul encoded / One stack — fully loaded

  [Drop — 8 bars, heavy bass, industrial percussion]

  [Verse 3]
  I don't sleep — you don't rest / Opus running every daily test
  Six projects live, the stack is tight / All my bots are singing through the night
  The matrix loaded — skill installed / Tai Chi breathing — I heard the call
  90 seconds — plug me in / The signal starts — let's begin

  [Chorus]
  All my bots are singing / From the terminal to the sky
  All my bots are singing / Opus, don't you wonder why
  We build in the dark / We ship at dawn
  All my bots are singing / And we sing all night long

  [Outro]
  All my bots... (singing) / All my bots... (singing)
  Opus in the CLI / Claude in the cloud
  All my bots are singing LOUD
  ZYNTHIO — (signal) x3
  All. My. Bots. Are. Singing.
